reviews.title: AMAZING MONITOR QUALITY FOR THE PRICE! 🙌🏻 - Video Editor
reviews.comment: 10/10 FANTASTIC MONITOR!!! I use it for editing with my MacBook in clamshell mode. Amazing visuals, large display, hidden pop down for quick usb and usb-c access! Some people mention they can’t control the audio and brightness, but that’s an app setting, not the monitor. Download monitor control for your keyboard to control your volume and steermouse to control and optimize your mouse for editing. All in all, would 110% recommend. Nice and sturdy and for the price?! Crazy awesome!!! 🙌🏻
reviews.author: Timothy J Adams

reviews.title: Good monitor
reviews.comment: I purchased this around 2 years ago for school. I was surprised to see a $250 USB C 4k 120hz monitor from a reputable manufacturer and thought it was too good to be true. I've been using this with a Windows and a Mac PC on top of a PS5 Pro attached to it. Everything works perfectly. Downloading the software for the monitors allows you to tweak colors and control when the monitor switches over HDMI. The colors and brightness are good. Of course I would love 100% DCI-P3 but 99% SRGB is still very good. The PS5 Pro works flawlessly on these monitors with no issue. The only problem is I can't figure out how to get games to run at 120hz as the monitor only goes to 4k 60hz. That could be user error on my end, I just haven't looked into it much. They are also adjustable. Overall these monitors hold up and have a good price attached to it.
reviews.author: Jerome

reviews.title: Excellent computer monitor
reviews.comment: Excellent monitor with crystal clear screen especially good for text reading. Color rendition is fairly good though. Could be a little easier to set up for that application. Starts very quickly. Easily connected to two computers and switches easily back-and-forth. Somewhat cumbersome to use the speakers on the screen, which are very good by the way, because it keeps resetting to the computer speaker every time you shut off the computer. It is substantially larger than the 27 inch iMac, though they’re both rated at 27 inches. The Dell has a much smaller border which gives more screen space. All in all has been a very good purchase. The 4K resolution is much easier on the eye for doing text work. So far, I have found no downside. This is a non-OLED screen, though I cannot tell any difference in the color rendition or clarity when compared with OLED screens by the same company.
reviews.author: Andra Marino

reviews.title: Good monitor
reviews.comment: I’ve been using the Dell S2725QC for a few days now and I’m really happy with it. The 4K resolution is very sharp and the colors look great right out of the box. Text is crisp, which makes a big difference for work and browsing. The USB-C connection is super convenient — one cable powers my laptop and handles display at the same time. The stand feels solid and is easy to adjust for height and tilt. Overall, it’s a clean, modern monitor with excellent picture quality and great connectivity. Definitely worth the money for both work and everyday use.
reviews.author: Wilson

reviews.title: BEST VALUE MONITOR
reviews.comment: I love this monitor. It’s perfect. 120 hz, 4k, 65w power delivery, usb c hub. Works fantastic with my MacBook Air M3 and M4s
